training_data_difference: GP marginal likelihood uses all 365 raw training observations per county, including 52 warmup weeks. Supervised forecasters have 313 training forecast targets. Both share the same available raw training observations.
interpretation: Independent stationary spectral graph-OU GP comparator inspired by Nikitin et al., not an exact SHEK reproduction. Fixed-topology validation pilot only. No final-test, changing-topology, biological or state-of-the-art claim.

fit.reference: Nikitin, John, Solin, Kaski. AISTATS 2022, PMLR 151:10640-10660
fit.graph: binary undirected combinatorial Laplacian, loops omitted
fit.likelihood: complete Gaussian observations, scalar standardized observation noise
fit.uncertainty: Gaussian plug-in hyperparameters, no calibration claim
fit.optimizer: L-BFGS-B with exact forward likelihood gradients
